contexts.text: Under Canaan (Land of), see these references. AC 1664:9. AC 1679. AC 4057. AC 4816:end. AC 6306. AC 8054:end. AC 8317. AC 9192:3. DP 328:4. AE 503:end. Coro 41:3.
Under Canaan (Ham's son), see these references. AC 1163.
The Canaanites () = the rest of the idolatrous worships.
The boundary of the Canaanites was from Zidon in coming to Gerar, even to Gaza () = the extension of Knowledges with those who have external worship without internal.
The Canaanite was then in the Land () = the hereditary evil from the mother in His external man.
The Canaanites were those who dwelt near the sea and near the banks of Jordan (), which also = evil in the external man, such as is what is hereditary from the mother.
All kinds of evils are signified by the idolatrous nations in the Canaanitish Land, among whom were the Canaanites. Illustrated.
And the Canaanite and the Perizzite were then dwelling in the Land () = evils and falsities in the external man. The Canaanites = hereditary evil from the mother in the external man.
The Canaanite = evil; the Perizzite, falsity.
They who had cultivated the doctrinal things of faith were called Canaanites, and were separated from the rest of the inhabitants of Canaan ().

Thou shalt not take a woman for my son (Isaac) from the daughters of the Canaanite () = that the Divine Rational should not be conjoined with any affection which is discordant with truth... The Canaanite = evil; hence the daughters of the Canaanite = affections which are discordant with truth. AC 3154:3.

The Canaanite and the Perizzite () = those who are in good and truth. The Canaanite here = those who are in the good of the Church; and the Perizzite, those who are in the truth of the Church. The reason they have this signification, is that the Ancient Church was still among them... So long therefore as anything of the Church remained among them, the Canaanite = the good of the Church, and the Perizzite, the truth of the Church; but when everything of the Church had been consummated among their, the Canaanite = evil, and the Perizzite, falsity.
Judah saw there the daughter of a Canaanite man () = the affection of evil from the falsity of evil... A Canaanite = evil.
Shaul the son of a Canaanitess () = what is doctrinal not from a genuine origin.
The inhabitant of the Land, the Canaanite () = the good of the Church.

To the place of the Canaanite and the Hittite () = the region occupied by evils and falsities. The Canaanites = evils from the falsities of evil; and the Hittites, falsities from which are evils. The nations in the Land of Canaan here enumerated = all kinds of evil and falsity. Illustrated. AC 8054. AC 10638. AE 650:59.
Shaul the son of a Canaanitess () = the things which are of truth in act outside the Church.
The Canaanite () = falsity from more grievous evil.
